UI_prof_RailroaderDesc: You worked the Knox County short line - hostling road switchers around the yard, priming the fuel pump on a cold morning until the diesel caught. The rails still go everywhere the roads do, and you are one of the few people left who can move anything on them.
UI_trait_RRRailroader_Desc: You can start and drive a locomotive: reverser, throttle notches, air brake. Without this, a cab full of levers means nothing to you.
